title.quote: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice

analysis.description: This paper discusses the statistical challenges in evaluating deep reinforcement learning algorithms, focusing on the variability and uncertainty in results due to the limited number of training runs. It highlights the discrepancies in current evaluation methodologies and offers more reliable statistical tools to improve the experimental rigour in deep RL research.

type.justification: The paper is empirical as it focuses on evaluating the performance of existing deep RL algorithms using experiments and statistical analysis, rather than proposing a new theoretical framework.
